method.pipeline: Production CaptionPipeline, StreamingSileroVAD, StreamingAudioConditioner, AsrWorker and MoonshineEngine
method.input: Prerecorded speech, paced in real time as 512-sample frames at 16 kHz; two seconds of silence appended
method.first_caption: First nonempty partial or final event, relative to the first frame in the confirmed VAD speech-start run
method.final_caption: Nonempty final event, relative to the last frame meeting the VAD speech-end threshold
method.timing_boundary: Backend caption emission, before WebSocket transport and UI painting
method.warmup: One discarded real-time pipeline replay per model before nine measured clips
method.summary: Median and observed minimum/maximum across three clips, each repeated three times
cautions: VAD-estimated boundaries, not human phonetic annotations; 32 ms resolution
One clean English reader, no accented/noisy/conversational latency generalization
In-use machines; no background applications were paused
Platform, runtime, hardware and workload effects have not been isolated
Requested thread environment does not prove the native Moonshine thread count
No older Intel or Snapdragon laptop measured

corpus.selection: First three ID-sorted clips from the prepared fixture

machines.stack: Windows development checkout, current preview speech pipeline
Mac preview source and bundled Python runtime
